leadText:
Rei Yamazaki (Japanese: 山崎玲愛 Yamazaki Rei) is an animator, illustrator, and character designer who has worked on the Pokémon series. She is one of the chief animation directors and the lead character designer for .

Yamazaki began working on the Pokémon series as a key animator for . She made her animation directorial debut on Rise and Shine, Starship! during . In addition to her work on the main Pokémon animated series, she also directed the first episode of Pokémon Evolutions, The Champion.

She is credited as Yamazaki Rei as an illustrator for the . She illustrates exclusively for cards related to the animated series. Her first cards were the and .
